stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The guide said every migration story includes both hope and loss.”?
options: When a tree becomes a point on a map with a name and history, it is harder to treat it as invisible.
She only wanted to give some small things a chance to become important later.
A suitcase is small, but it can hold a turning point in a family's history.
Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.
